verdicts.title: Canzonetta, Op. 52 No. 2
verdicts.note: IMSLP page "2 Lieder, Op.52" documents only No. 2, published for violin (or cello) and piano as "Canzonetta" (Jibneh-Edition, Berlin 1923, plate J.-E. 34); the IMSLP list says it is the violin version of the song "Licht so träumend". gaps.title: 2 Pastels, Op. 44
gaps.edition: Carl Fischer 1917 (per IMSLP list of works)
gaps.note: No IMSLP score page; Wikipedia lists "2 Pastels, Op. 44" for violin and orchestra (1917), so the scoring should be checked. Gap check otherwise complete: Violin Concertos Nos. 2-3 (Opp. 68, 72) and Op. 74 are manuscript-only; no Violin Sonata No. 3 appears in IMSLP or Wikipedia; Children's Suite Op. 57 is for clarinet/strings/piano; Achron's arrangements of other composers (Grieg, Liszt, Paganini, etc.) belong to those composers.

existing_issues.issue: IMSLP has two distinct sets: "2 Stimmungen, Op.32" (Universal Edition 1910) and "2 Stimmungen, Op.36" (queued N14). Title should show the number of pieces to tell them apart.
